bullets.id: Emas spot melemah 0,4% ke $3.868,88 di awal sesi Asia Senin menurut Investing.com, kembali di bawah $3.900 setelah rugi 4,5% pekan lalu. Perak turun 2,1% ke $47,74. Pejabat Fed Jeff Schmid menyebut inflasi “terlalu panas”, sementara Susan Collins menilai bunga mungkin perlu naik lebih jauh. Pasar kini menunggu pidato Ketua Fed Kevin Warsh pada Senin.
bullets.en: Spot gold slipped 0.4% to $3,868.88 in early Asian trade on Monday according to Investing.com, back below $3,900 after last week’s 4.5% loss. Silver fell 2.1% to $47.74. Fed official Jeff Schmid said inflation is “running too hot”, while Susan Collins said rates may need to rise further. Markets now await Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech on Monday.

bullets.id: CME FedWatch memberi peluang 94% untuk kenaikan 25 bps pada Desember dan 6% untuk 50 bps. Indeks dolar di 103,44 dan yield Treasury 10 tahun sekitar 5,14%. Trading Economics mencatat emas turun 6,45% dalam sebulan dan sekitar 31% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 pada Januari 2026.
bullets.en: CME FedWatch puts the odds of a 25 bp December hike at 94% and of 50 bp at 6%. The dollar index is at 103.44 and the 10-year Treasury yield near 5.14%. Trading Economics shows gold down 6.45% over the month and about 31% below its $5,608.35 record from January 2026.

bullets.id: Kitco mencatat support di $3.852, terendah tahun ini, lalu $3.823, dengan resistance di $3.903–$3.934. RoboForex memperkirakan rentang pekan ini $3.790–$3.900. Agenda: pidato Warsh Senin, penjualan ritel Oktober Selasa dan risalah rapat Fed Rabu 18 November.
bullets.en: Kitco lists support at $3,852, the year’s low, then $3,823, with resistance at $3,903–$3,934. RoboForex expects a $3,790–$3,900 range this week. Agenda: Warsh’s speech on Monday, October retail sales on Tuesday and the Fed minutes on Wednesday, 18 November.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram naik Rp5.000 ke Rp2.522.000 dengan buyback naik Rp5.000 ke Rp2.298.000, sehingga spread tetap Rp224.000 (sekitar 8,9%). Galeri24 tetap Rp2.456.000 (buyback Rp2.312.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS tetap Rp2.480.000 (buyback Rp2.286.000, spread sekitar 7,8%).
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price rose Rp5,000 to Rp2,522,000 with buyback up Rp5,000 to Rp2,298,000, keeping the spread at Rp224,000 (about 8.9%). Galeri24 held at Rp2,456,000 (buyback Rp2,312,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS held at Rp2,480,000 (buyback Rp2,286,000, spread about 7.8%).
